title: Gemini Gem context as one bundle, uploaded through librclone
question: What was measured for Gemini Gem context as one bundle, uploaded through librclone?
workload: 2026-10-26: Gemini Gem context as one bundle, uploaded through librclone
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Not measured: the `wf rca ask` draft quality (no answer within 150 s from the sandbox; the checklist run belongs on the VM) and a real Drive upload (`docs/gaps/gemini-sync-unverified.md`).

rows: - Spike (n=1, Sonnet-free): a release binary linking it is 92.8 MB against 13.2 MB for today's static `wf`; an incremental release build took 12.5 s. A local `operations/copyfile` and its `object not found` error work, and a `:drive,scope=drive,token='{...}',root_folder_id=...:` connection string reached Google (401 for a fake token) from the sandbox, so no config file or environment is needed. Decision from the size: the dependency is the optional cargo feature `rclone` of `knowledge`, off in the shared `wf` build (which is also a musl static binary); the nightly workflow builds `knowledge --features rclone` and flow-tests the upload against a local remote first.
- Not measured: the `wf rca ask` draft quality (no answer within 150 s from the sandbox; the checklist run belongs on the VM) and a real Drive upload (`docs/gaps/gemini-sync-unverified.md`).

- vnc-auth: `Launcher::run_login` no longer takes the lock a navigation holds (the desktop user is a field of the launcher); a flow journey with a never-answering browser endpoint failed with a 20 s client timeout before the change and passes in under a second after it. Merge: `origin/main` was `dev@c82c316dd` (a squash), recorded with `merge -s ours`; the Metro and emulator memory caps of 2026-10-13 are moot because that container infra was retired (`0ca9ab744`).
